versions.changelog:
Initial release of the update-cursor-settings skill.

- Enables modification of Codex/VSCode user settings in settings.json.
- Supports common editor preferences such as font size, theme, tab size, formatting options, and keybindings.
- Provides clear instructions for safely reading, updating, and writing back settings while preserving existing configuration and comments.
- Clarifies difference between user and workspace settings, and notes about commit attribution.
- Lists common user requests mapped to settings for easy reference.
- Includes important notes on JSON comments, reload requirements, and backup options.
